title: 独坐敬亭山
author: 李白
intro: The birds fly off, the last cloud drifts away, and Li Bai is left alone with a mountain. They look at each other and never tire of it — the mountain has become his only friend.
analysis: 这首诗是李白晚年在宣城写的。前两句写身边的东西一个个离开：鸟群高高飞走，越飞越远，看不见了；天上只有一片云，也悠闲地飘走了。连鸟和云都不陪他，诗人的孤独一点点加深。后两句一转：只有敬亭山，我看它，它看我，谁也看不厌。山本来不会看人，诗人却把它写得像人一样，这叫“拟人”。山越有情，越说明人间没有可以说话的人——这是用“热闹”写孤单。但这份孤单又很平静：诗人和山相对，好像找到了真正懂自己的朋友。“相看两不厌”今天也常用来形容两个人（或人和地方）怎么看都不腻。
analysisEn: Li Bai wrote this late in life, in Xuancheng (in today’s Anhui). In the first two lines, everything around him leaves one by one: a flock of birds flies higher and further until it disappears; a single cloud drifts lazily away. Not even the birds and clouds will stay with him, and his loneliness grows. Then the poem turns: only Jingting Mountain remains. I look at it, it looks at me, and neither of us ever gets tired. A mountain can’t really look at anyone — the poet treats it like a person, which is called nǐrén, personification. The warmer the mountain seems, the clearer it is that he has no human company: loneliness is shown through a kind of friendship. Yet the mood is calm, not bitter. Facing the mountain, he seems to have found a friend who truly understands him. The phrase 相看两不厌 is still used today for two people — or a person and a place — who never tire of each other.
background: Li Bai (701–762) visited Xuancheng several times in his later years, after leaving the court in Chang’an disappointed. Jingting Mountain lies just north of the city; the poem is usually dated to around 753.
pronunciation: 相看 xiāng kàn（统编教材注 kàn；旧注有读 kān 的）。厌 yàn。
version: 采用通行的教材版本，各本基本无异文。

lines.lit: The many birds fly high until they are gone;
lines.en: The birds have flown high and out of sight;

lines.lit: a lone cloud goes off alone, at ease.
lines.en: one idle cloud drifts off on its own.

lines.lit: Looking at each other, neither tires;
lines.en: We gaze at each other and never tire —

words.note: 孤：单独一个，现代汉语“孤单”。
相：互相，现代汉语“相信”“相爱”。

words.en: to be tired of; to be fed up with
words.note: 现代汉语“讨厌”“厌倦”“百看不厌”。

imagery.name: 鸟
imagery.zh: 鸟群飞走、不再回来，一个个离开的东西衬出诗人的孤单。
imagery.en: The birds fly away and don’t come back — one more thing leaving him on his own.

imagery.name: 云
imagery.zh: 孤云悠闲地飘走，像诗人自己，也像连云都不肯陪他。
imagery.en: The lone cloud drifting away is like the poet himself — and one more companion gone.

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 敬亭山被写得像人一样有情，是诗人唯一的知己。
imagery.en: Jingting Mountain is written as if it has feelings — the poet’s only true friend.
